intro: We service and repair continental cars: BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Volkswagen, MINI and Peugeot. Our workshop is at 17, Jalan Hang Lekir 12, Taman Industri Jaya, Skudai.
From a full service to engine work and electronic programming, we handle it in one workshop.

paras: We work on European cars every week. Asian makes are welcome too.
Full service jobs we have done include the Porsche Macan S and the Mercedes C250. We check the car on the lift and explain what we find.
BMW B48 valve stem seal replacement is one of the jobs we have done. We have also removed BMW turbochargers for repair.
Many continental cars need software work after a repair. We have done radiator-fan temperature programming on a Mini Cooper S and DCC programming on a VW Passat.

faqs.a: We work on BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Volkswagen, MINI and Peugeot.

faqs.a: Yes. We have done full services on a Porsche Macan S and a Mercedes C250.

faqs.a: Yes. We have replaced BMW B48 valve stem seals and removed BMW turbochargers for repair.
